experiment: ACCEL-1: budget-bounded local 3060 research loop with Teacher Replay Warehouse, compute-normalized successive elimination and Modal-only confirmation

authority.evidence_basis: QNATIVE-2 cancelled under ~$5-remaining Modal budget after retaining all failed receipts; NATIVE-2 completed cross-only development win preserved at ceee5d8.
authority.supersedes_nothing: No prior protocol, sealed gate or completed evidence is replaced. Historical QNATIVE-2 implementations, datasets and receipts stay valid and unused unless a future confirmatory rerun is preregistered as an isolated legacy lane.

budget.enforcement: Every Modal call records GPU seconds and cost estimate; a spend ledger keeps a running total and refuses once cumulative cost plus a function reservation would exceed the cap. No exploratory multi-hour job may start.
budget.overshoot_rule: If any revert shows spend above the hard remaining budget, all pending Modal reservations are cancelled immediately and the overrun is reported as failure evidence.

host_thermal_policy.duty_cycle: Pause the training process with SIGSTOP immediately on exceeding the ceiling; resume with SIGCONT only after at least 60 cool-down seconds and the resume floor reached. Never run an unmanaged all-core or all-SM loop.
host_thermal_policy.power: Power limits are not set in software without root; duty cycle plus pausing is the controlled mitigation.

hardware_benchmark.purpose: Only after a candidate can fit and be numerically proven on the 3060; compare T4/L4/A10/A100 on one bounded 10-minute workload

research_method.CNSR: Compute-normalized successive research. Each candidate arm receives equal allowed GPU-seconds on the 3060 (round budget), not equal epochs. Quality gain per GPU-second decides advancement. This corrects equal-epoch unfairness for sparse mechanisms.
research_method.TRW: Teacher Replay Warehouse. Run the existing NATIVE-2 cross checkpoint once over the FIT+selection QASPER/intent pools needed by accelerated arms; persist candidate logits, gold margins, token-level scores and block-level supervision targets. Every accelerated arm consumes the warehouse first; no arm reruns the teacher.
screening_ladder: 5% FWS-aware QASPER screen + intent hard-negative screen at 1-2 fixed epochs
fuller 3060 fit only for the winner
research_method.promotion: A development winner must meet preregistered absolute-quality and per-compute gates on its own held-out screen, and must beat the NATIVE-2 cross quality on the exact QASPER DEV where applicable. No Modal run on an unproven arm.

arms_to_screen: AMP + sequence-batch ladder (8/16/32/64) on full-window cross training within VRAM
Frontier Window Sampling (FWS): all positive + hard negatives + coverage negatives; exact exhaustive evaluation retained
Hard candidate subsets for intent training with exact full-catalogue evaluation
Frozen Prefix Activation Warehouse (FPAW): freeze prefix, cached features, full-equivalence smoke
SplitCross lower-layer separation, later fused layers

controls.necessary_controls: Exact same input ledger, same random seeds, same evaluation pass over the full exhaustive DEV catalogues; dual lanes keep gold availability and dropout.
controls.gold_leakage: Never train with, evaluate or pretrain on DEV metadata beyond registered split and input-only window construction.

metrics.quality: Per-arm DEV primary metric as registered in NATIVE-2 / QNATIVE-2 lineage, undecayed by partial training budget until final.

gates.screen_tournament: Arms ranked by quality/GPU-second; cycle from round 1 to round 2 only when declared in protocol. No outcome-guided re-splits or seed shopping.
gates.survivor: The surviving mechanism must show a statistically real quality gain over the completed NATIVE-2 cross comparator on the same DEV units with 10,000-draw component bootstrap and nominal 95% intervals.
gates.spend: Modal spend ledger enforced client-side; budget breach aborts the queued job before start.

failure: Retain every failed screen, thermal stop, OOM and quality result. The same mechanism family that fails three times (insufficient transfer, compute blowup or protocol violation) is retired; the next branch comes from this protocol, not silent tweaks.
next_branch: If a local winner meets quality and compute gates, preregister one Modal final confirmatory run on T4/L4/A10 within $1.50 and one auxiliary hardware benchmark within the same cap. If no arm survives CNSR, the mechanism family stops and the research returns to intent/Choice/Score with the NATIVE-2 cross teacher as the only certified artifact.
